bias.en: Bullish · pulling back from the December highs
bias.zh: 偏多 · 自去年 12 月高点回落

read.en: Zscaler fell 3.4% on Oct 14 to $220.79. It slipped below its 5-day average ($225.2) and is above the 10-day ($214.9), 30-day ($197.8), 100-day ($165.7) and 200-day ($166.0, edging lower). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 7 with a narrowing histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 6 ($202.7), and RSI is 61.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月14日下跌 3.4%，收于 $220.79。股价跌破 5 日均线（$225.2），并在 10 日（$214.9）、30 日（$197.8）、100 日（$165.7）和 200 日均线（$166.0，小幅下行）上方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线上方，柱状图收窄，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起看多（$202.7），RSI 为 61。

read.en: The $224 support (5-day average, Oct 13 low) broke, with a day's low of $220.08, and turns into resistance; above it the $235–237 December 2025 highs still cap, then $250. Support is $215–217 (10-day average, Sep 24 high), then $203 (SAR) and $198 (30-day average). A close below $215 would open $203; a close above $237 would target $250.
read.zh: $224 支撑（5 日均线、10月13日低点）失守，当日低点 $220.08，该位置转为阻力；其上 2025年12月的 $235–237 高点仍构成压制，再往上为 $250。支撑为 $215–217（10 日均线、9月24日高点），其次 $203（SAR）和 $198（30 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $215，下一目标看 $203；收盘站上 $237 则目标看 $250。
